query: I sent you a cheque a few days ago and I noticed that nothing has happened yet. Can you tell me the status of my cheque please?
canonical_answer: Cash deposited at a Chinor ATM is credited immediately, and cash deposited at a branch counter is credited by the end of the same business day. Chinor does not accept cheques, so a cheque cannot be credited. If a cash deposit is still missing after that time, a human agent can check it with the deposit receipt.
rewrite: Chinor does not accept cheques, so a cheque cannot be credited. If your deposit is still missing after these times, a human agent can check it with the deposit receipt.

query: My card expires next week. How do I get a new one?
canonical_answer: A replacement card is sent automatically, free of charge, 45 days before your card expires, to the address in your profile. Your current card keeps working until the last day of its expiry month. When the new card arrives, activate it in the app under Cards → Activate.
rewrite: A replacement card is sent automatically 45 days before your card expires, to the address in your profile. Your current card keeps working until the last day of its expiry month. When the new card arrives, activate it in the app under Cards → Activate.

query: I want to link my new card. Can you help?
canonical_answer: You can link a Visa, Mastercard, UzCard or Humo card issued in your own name under Account → Top up → Add card, and use it for manual or automatic top-ups. Debit-card top-ups are free; credit-card top-ups carry a 1.1 % fee.
rewrite: To link your new card, go to Account → Top up → Add card. You can add a Visa, Mastercard, UzCard, or Humo card issued in your own name for manual or automatic top-ups. Debit-card top-ups are free, while credit-card top-ups have a 1.1 % fee.

query: Some cash withdrawal that I didn't make showed up in the app.
canonical_answer: Please check the ATM location and time under the transaction in the app. If you did not make the withdrawal, freeze the card immediately, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22, and raise a dispute from the transaction screen within 60 days of the statement date.
rewrite: If you did not make the withdrawal, freeze the card immediately, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22, and raise a dispute from the transaction screen within 60 days of the statement date.

query: I attemped a transfer and it didn't go through.
canonical_answer: A failed transfer is returned to your balance within 2 business days, and the app shows the reason — most often wrong recipient details, a limit, sanctions screening or insufficient balance. Correct the details and send it again; if it fails again for no shown reason, a human agent can check it.
rewrite: The failed transfer is returned to your balance within 2 business days, and the app shows the reason. query: How do I go about ordering another card?
canonical_answer: A spare (second) physical card is included in the Chinor Plus plan. On Standard, an additional physical card beyond the plan allowance costs 35,000 UZS. Order it under Cards → Order card; delivery takes 7 business days.
rewrite: If you're on the Plus plan, a second physical card is included at no extra cost. On the Standard plan, an additional card costs 35,000 UZS. You can order it under Cards → Order card; delivery takes 7 business days.

query: My card is missing!  Help!
canonical_answer: Freeze the card immediately in the app under Cards → Freeze, on the web portal, or by calling the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22. Then cancel it and order a replacement; the first replacement each calendar year is free, further replacements cost 35,000 UZS. Dispute any transaction you do not recognise within 60 days.
rewrite: Freeze the card immediately in the app under Cards → Freeze, on the web portal, or by calling the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22. The first replacement each calendar year is free. Dispute any transaction you do not recognise within 60 days.

query: My cash withdrawal shows pending, why?
canonical_answer: A pending ATM withdrawal settles within 4 business days; the amount is already reserved, so you will not be charged twice when it settles. If it is still pending after that, a human agent can check it.
rewrite: A cash withdrawal showing as pending means the amount is already reserved and will settle within 4 business days. If it remains pending after that time, a human agent can look into it.

query: I tried to top up, but the funds show up as pending. I thought it was instant?
canonical_answer: Card top-ups are normally instant but can take up to 2 business days when the card issuer holds them; bank-transfer top-ups are credited within 1 business day. If the time has passed, ask your card issuer or bank whether the payment left, and a human agent can trace it with the reference.
rewrite: Top-ups made with a card are normally instant but can take up to 2 business days when the card issuer holds them; bank-transfer top-ups are credited within 1 business day. query: Tell me why my transfer is pending.
canonical_answer: A transfer shows Scheduled until it leaves Chinor and Sent afterwards. Domestic transfers to other banks arrive the same business day if sent before 16:30, otherwise the next business day; international transfers take 2–4 business days. While it is Scheduled you can still cancel it in the app.

query: My PIN is not working, can you help?
canonical_answer: After 3 wrong attempts the PIN is blocked. Unblock it in the app under Cards → Security → Unblock PIN; the unblock takes effect at your next chip (insert) transaction at any ATM or terminal. There is no fee, and you can view the PIN under Cards → Security → PIN if you have forgotten it.
rewrite: After 3 wrong attempts, the PIN is blocked. You can unblock it in the app under Cards → Security → Unblock PIN; the unblock takes effect at your next chip transaction at any ATM or terminal.

query: It's been more than a week since I had a return charged to my card, why hasn't it showed up?
canonical_answer: A merchant refund can take up to 12 business days to appear after the merchant issues it. Please contact the merchant first to confirm the refund was sent; if they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the refund request.
rewrite: A merchant refund can take up to 12 business days to appear after the merchant issues it. You should contact the merchant first to confirm the refund was sent; if they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the refund request.

query: Close down my account.  I don't like your service.
canonical_answer: You can request closure in the app under Profile → Close account. Your balance must be zero and there must be no pending transactions or open disputes; closure is completed within 14 days, and your statements stay downloadable from the web portal for 5 years.
rewrite: To close your account, you can request closure in the app under Profile → Close account. Your balance must be zero with no pending transactions or open disputes; closure is completed within 14 days.

query: I want to do a swift transfer
canonical_answer: Topping up by bank transfer is free and the money is credited within 1 business day. Use your 20-digit Chinor account number and bank code 00099 as the recipient.
rewrite: You can do a bank transfer to top up your account for free, and the funds will be credited within 1 business day. Use your 20-digit Chinor account number and the bank code 00099 as the recipient.

query: What's the limit to how much I can top up?
canonical_answer: Top-up limits are 30,000,000 UZS per day and 100,000,000 UZS per month. Single top-ups above 10,000,000 UZS, or total deposits above 50,000,000 UZS in a month, may require proof of the source of funds, which you upload in the app within 10 days.
rewrite: The daily top-up limit is 30,000,000 UZS and the monthly limit is 100,000,000 UZS. If a single deposit exceeds 10,000,000 UZS or total deposits are over 50,000,000 UZS in a month, you may need to upload proof of the source of funds in the app within 10 days.
note: "If a single deposit exceeds 10,000,000 UZS" scope

query: I thought that transfers are free. Why was I charged an extra fee?
canonical_answer: Domestic transfers are free up to 20 per month; from the 21st transfer the fee is 2,500 UZS each. International transfers cost 0.8 % with a 60,000 UZS minimum, and foreign-currency transfers at the weekend carry the 0.9 % markup. The fee is shown as a separate line under the transfer.
rewrite: Domestic transfers are free for the first 20 per month; the 21st and any subsequent transfers cost 2,500 UZS each. International transfers are charged at 0.8 % with a 60,000 UZS minimum. The fee is shown as a separate line under the transfer.

query: Is there extra fees for making a withdraw in a different country at a cash machine.
canonical_answer: If the ATM offered to convert the withdrawal into your home currency and you accepted, the ATM operator's own rate applied (dynamic currency conversion), which Chinor cannot refund. Chinor's own conversion uses the interbank mid-market rate plus the 0.9 % weekend markup; always choose to withdraw in the local currency.

Chinor's own conversion uses the interbank mid-market rate plus the 0.9 % weekend markup; always choose to withdraw in the local currency.

query: HOW LONG TO TAKE THE TIME TO SOLVE
canonical_answer: Please check in the app that the card is activated and not frozen, that the relevant toggle under Cards → Security (contactless, online, ATM, magnetic stripe) is switched on, and that your daily limit has not been reached. If a chip card fails at every terminal it is treated as damaged and replaced free of charge.
rewrite: If your card is not working, please check in the app that it is activated and not frozen, and review the settings under Cards → Security to ensure the relevant functions are enabled. If the card is damaged and fails at every terminal, it will be replaced free of charge.
note: "If the card is damaged and fails at every terminal, it will be replaced free of charge" condition

query: Why was my atm withdrawl declined
canonical_answer: A withdrawal is usually declined because the 6,000,000 UZS daily ATM limit was reached, ATM withdrawals are switched off under Cards → Security, the PIN was wrong, the ATM does not support your card network, or the ATM is out of cash. The reason is shown under the attempt in the app.
rewrite: Your ATM withdrawal may have been declined if the 6,000,000 UZS daily limit was reached, ATM withdrawals are switched off under Cards → Security, the PIN was wrong, the ATM does not support your card network, or the ATM is out of cash. Check the reason under the attempt in the app.

query: Why was I charged more than I should have been?
canonical_answer: Every fee appears as a separate line under the transaction in the app. The possible fees are the 0.9 % weekend markup, the 0.6 % fee above the exchange allowance, the 0.5 % fee at gambling or money-transfer merchants, the 1.3 % fee above the free ATM allowance, the 1.1 % credit-card top-up fee, and the 25,000 UZS Plus subscription. If the fee line does not match any of these, a human agent can review it.
rewrite: The fee appears as a separate line under the transaction in the app. Possible fees include the 0.9 % weekend markup or the 1.3 % fee above the free ATM allowance. If the line doesn't match these or other listed fees, a human agent can review it.

query: I have been trying unsuccessfully to top-up my card.  Is the system down or not working properly?
canonical_answer: A top-up usually fails because the card issuer declined it, the card is not in your own name, the 30,000,000 UZS daily or 100,000,000 UZS monthly top-up limit was reached, or 3-D Secure was not completed. The reason is shown under the attempt in the app; if money left your card anyway, it is returned within 5 business days.

query: At what places accept my card?
canonical_answer: Chinor cards work in more than 180 countries wherever the Visa or Mastercard network is accepted, except in countries under international sanctions. If a merchant declines the card, the app shows the decline reason under the transaction.
rewrite: Chinor cards are accepted in over 180 countries wherever Visa or Mastercard is accepted, except in countries under international sanctions. If a transaction is declined, the app will show the reason under the transaction details.

query: I had a decline on my card. Why?
canonical_answer: The decline reason is shown under the transaction in the app. Common causes are insufficient balance in the payment currency, a frozen card, a blocked merchant category or toggle under Cards → Security, the daily limit, the merchant not completing 3-D Secure, or a fraud-monitoring check that asks you to confirm the payment in the app.

query: I would like to cancel my previous transaction
canonical_answer: A domestic transfer can be cancelled in the app only while its status is Scheduled; once it shows Sent it cannot be cancelled. An international (SWIFT) transfer can be recalled within 24 hours of sending for a 90,000 UZS recall fee, but recall is not guaranteed because the receiving bank must agree.

query: What's the fee for exchange of foreign currencies?
canonical_answer: Exchange is free up to 15,000,000 UZS equivalent per month on Standard and unlimited on Plus; above the Standard allowance a 0.6 % fee applies. From Saturday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 a 0.9 % weekend markup is added because markets are closed.

query: Why was I double charged?
canonical_answer: If one of the two entries is still pending, it is usually a duplicate authorisation and drops off automatically within 9 business days. If both entries have settled, raise a dispute for the duplicate from the transaction screen within 60 days of the statement date; for amounts under 5,000,000 UZS a provisional credit is applied within 10 business days.
rewrite: If one of the two charges is still pending, it is likely a duplicate authorization and will drop off automatically within 9 business days. If both have settled, you can raise a dispute for the duplicate from the transaction screen within 60 days of the statement date.

query: On my transfer there was a "decline" message
canonical_answer: A transfer is declined when the details are wrong, a limit is reached, the beneficiary fails sanctions screening, or the balance is insufficient; the app shows the reason on the transfer. Declined or failed transfers are returned to your balance within 2 business days.
rewrite: Your transfer was declined for the reason shown in the app. Declined or failed transfers are returned to your balance within 2 business days.

query: If I am not in the country and I need to change my PIN, how can this be done?
canonical_answer: You can view or change your 4-digit PIN in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming your passcode and biometrics. There is no fee, and the new PIN works from the next chip transaction.
rewrite: You can change your 4-digit PIN in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming your passcode and biometrics. There is no fee, and the new PIN works from the next chip transaction.

query: I just replaced my phone but how do I use my card information?
canonical_answer: Log in on the Chinor web portal to freeze all your cards and sign out all devices; your passcode and biometric login stop working on the lost phone as soon as you sign in on a new device. If you cannot access the portal, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

query: Please tell me how disposable virtual cards work?
canonical_answer: Go to Cards → New virtual card in the app and choose Disposable. It is created instantly and free on both plans; the details regenerate after each payment, and you can create up to 6 per day with a maximum of 3,000,000 UZS per payment.
